title: YouTube Tag Counter
description: Count your YouTube tags and total characters against the 500-character limit — with per-tag lengths and duplicate flags.
howto: Paste your tags, separated by commas or new lines.
See the tag count and total characters vs YouTube's 500-character limit.
Remove duplicates and over-long tags flagged in the table.

faqs.a: 500 characters total across all tags. This tool sums the characters of your tags (commas excluded) and shows how much headroom remains.

faqs.q: How long can one tag be?
faqs.a: YouTube allows up to 30 words per tag in practice; very long single tags are flagged here at 60+ characters so you can split them.

faqs.q: Do tags still matter for ranking?
faqs.a: Less than they used to — title, description and watch time matter more. But accurate tags still help with misspellings and discovery.
